portInfo.description: Grand Bahama cruise calls use the Freeport Harbour complex (Hutchison Ports Bahamas FCP and FHC). Operator websites may not list pier dimensions or passenger-door coordinates—confirm your berth and shuttle plan on sailing documents and with the cruise line before you go ashore.

politics.visaRequirements: Visa-free for US, Canada, EU, UK citizens (up to 90 days). Others may need visa.
politics.entryRequirements: Valid passport required. Return ticket may be required.

gettingThere.fromTerminal: Confirm whether you berth at Lucayan Harbour / Freeport Harbour cruise facilities—names on daily port programmes differ. These are not interchangeable with Nassau.
gettingThere.distanceToCity: Walking and transfer times depend on which berth or tender point you use. Confirm with terminal staff and your ship before planning independent transport.
gettingThere.publicTransport: Taxis and resort shuttles are common when ships are in port; routes to Port Lucaya or beaches are not guaranteed without a confirmed pier—verify locally.
gettingThere.distanceAnswer: Walking and transfer times depend on which berth or tender point you use. Confirm with terminal staff and your ship before planning independent transport.

thingsToDo.intro: Pick one neighbourhood or excursion scale and keep time for the gangway queue on the way back.
topThings: Port Lucaya / marketplace—only when your call uses confirmed Freeport Harbour landings and transfers.
Grand Bahama beach time—conditional on berth, weather, and agreed return time.
Organised snorkel or nature tours—book through the ship or verified operators with a generous all-aboard buffer.
thingsToDo.shortCall: Stay near the port area and keep a generous buffer before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.standardCall: Combine a central walk, one attraction, and lunch if times allow—start back well before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.longerCall: A second stop or coach outing is realistic only with confirmed transport and an eight-hour or longer window.
thingsToDo.practicalTip: Match the facility name on your sailing documents before booking independent transport.
